Embedding request via Azure OpenAI using the azure/ provider prefix — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape that Azure returns unchanged

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"azure/text-embedding-ada-002\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(request: _request)
print(result)
```
